tasks.statement_en:
The number $\log_9 27 + \log_9 3$ equals

tasks.summary_pl: Ceny po obniżkach 15% i 20% to 340 zł. Cena początkowa?
tasks.summary_en: After 15% then 20% discounts price is 340 PLN. Original price?
tasks.statement_en:
The price of a camera was reduced by 15%, and then by 20% relative to the price at that time. After these two reductions the camera costs 340 PLN. Before both reductions the price of this camera was equal to
A. 500 PLN  B. 425 PLN  C. 400 PLN  D. 375 PLN

answer is a system of equations, not a number

One of the solutions of the equation $\sqrt3(x^2-2)(x+3)=0$ is the number
A. 3  B. 2  C. $\sqrt3$  D. $\sqrt2$

tasks.notes: options describe the solution set qualitatively, not a number

tasks.summary_pl: Miejsce zerowe $-5$, wierzchołek ma $x=3$. Drugie miejsce zerowe?
tasks.summary_en: One zero is $-5$, vertex has $x=3$. Find the other zero
tasks.statement_en:
One of the zeros of the quadratic function f is the number $(-5)$. The first coordinate of the vertex of the parabola that is the graph of f equals 3. The other zero of f is the number
A. 11  B. 1  C. $(-1)$  D. $(-13)$

tasks.summary_en: Sequence $a_n=2^n\cdot(n+1)$. Find $a_4$
tasks.statement_en:
The sequence $(a_n)$ is defined by $a_n=2^n\cdot(n+1)$ for every natural number $n\ge1$. The term $a_4$ equals
A. 64  B. 40  C. 48  D. 80

tasks.summary_en: Sequence $(27,9,a-1)$ is geometric. Find $a$
tasks.statement_en:
The three-term sequence $(27,9,a-1)$ is geometric. The number a equals
A. 3  B. 0  C. 4  D. 2

tasks.summary_en: Angle $\alpha$'s arm passes through $P=(-3,1)$. Find $\tan\alpha$
tasks.statement_en:
[Figure: angle alpha with vertex O=(0,0), one arm on the positive x-axis, the other through P=(-3,1)] The tangent of angle alpha equals
A. $\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}$  B. $-\frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}$  C. $-3$  D. $-\frac13$

tasks.notes: answer sin^2(alpha) is symbolic in alpha, not a number

tasks.statement_en:

tasks.summary_pl: Romb: bok $6\sqrt2$, kąt rozwarty $150°$. Iloczyn przekątnych?
tasks.summary_en: Rhombus: side $6\sqrt2$, obtuse angle $150°$. Product of diagonals?
tasks.statement_en:
In a rhombus with side length $6\sqrt2$ the obtuse angle has measure 150 deg. The product of the diagonals of this rhombus equals
A. 24  B. 72  C. 36  D. $36\sqrt2$

tasks.summary_pl: Styczne z $C$ do okręgu, kąt środkowy $140°$. Oblicz kąt $ACB$
tasks.summary_en: Tangents from C to a circle, central angle $140°$. Find angle ACB
tasks.statement_en:
[Figure: tangent lines to a circle with center O through points A and B meet at C; angle AOB = 140 deg] The measure of angle ACB equals
A. 20°  B. 35°  C. 40°  D. 70°

tasks.summary_en: Triangle: $|BC|=6$, angle $ACB=150°$. Find the height from B
tasks.statement_en:
[Figure: triangle ABC with |BC|=6, angle ACB = 150 deg] The height of triangle ABC dropped from vertex B equals
A. 3  B. 4  C. $3\sqrt3$  D. $4\sqrt3$

tasks.summary_en: Line parallel to $y=-\frac13x+2$ through $(3,5)$: $a+b$? (a + b)
tasks.statement_en:
The line k has equation $y=-\frac13x+2$. The line with equation $y=ax+b$ is parallel to line k and passes through point P=(3,5) when
A. $a=3$ and $b=4$  B. $a=-\frac13$ and $b=4$  C. $a=3$ and $b=-4$  D. $a=-\frac13$ and $b=6$
tasks.notes: closed option gives a pair (a,b); summed per sum-of-parameters rule

tasks.summary_en: $S=(5,3)$ is midpoint of KL, $K=(-3,-7)$. Find $x_L+y_L$ (x + y)
tasks.statement_en:
Points K=(-3,-7) and S=(5,3) are given. Point S is the midpoint of segment KL. Then point L has coordinates
A. $(13,10)$  B. $(13,13)$  C. $(1,-2)$  D. $(7,-1)$

tasks.notes: answer is an equation of a line

tasks.summary_en: Prism: base edge 15, $\cos\alpha=\frac{\sqrt2}{3}$. Find the diagonal
tasks.statement_en:
A regular quadrilateral prism has a base edge of length 15. The diagonal of the prism is inclined to the base plane at an angle alpha such that $\cos\alpha=\frac{\sqrt2}{3}$. The length of the prism's diagonal equals
A. $15\sqrt2$  B. 45  C. $5\sqrt2$  D. 10

tasks.summary_en: Mean of x,y,z is 4. Find mean of $1{+}x,2{+}y,3{+}z,14$
tasks.statement_en:
The arithmetic mean of numbers x,y,z equals 4. The arithmetic mean of the four numbers $1+x, 2+y, 3+z, 14$ equals
A. 6  B. 9  C. 8  D. 13

tasks.summary_en: How many 5-digit numbers use only digits 0,5,7?
tasks.statement_en:
The number of all 5-digit natural numbers whose decimal representation uses only the digits 0,5,7 (e.g. 57075, 55555) equals
A. $5^3$  B. $2\cdot4^3$  C. $2\cdot3^4$  D. $3^5$

tasks.notes: final answer is the name of a polygon (base shape), not a number

tasks.summary_en: Prism ABCDEF: find total surface area and volume (P + V)
tasks.statement_en: [Figure: right prism ABCDEF with isosceles triangular base ABC] The base of the right prism ABCDEF is an isosceles triangle ABC with |AC|=|BC|, |AB|=8. The height of triangle ABC from vertex C has length 3. The diagonal CE of the lateral face forms a 60 deg angle with base edge CB. Calculate the total surface area and the volume of this prism.
tasks.notes: value is the sum of surface area (24+90sqrt3) and volume (60sqrt3) per the sum-of-numeric-parts rule
